name: BrainyPress
author: BrainyPress

sections.description:
Meet BrainyPress v2.8: Your Free Auto-Writer for WordPress.

BrainyPress is a fully automated content machine designed to rank on Google. Whether you want to run it on Auto-Pilot (Server Cron) while you sleep or trigger posts Manually, BrainyPress handles it all.

Unlike old-school spinners, BrainyPress uses Google Gemini 2.0 Flash (Free API) with Real-Time Search Grounding to write factually accurate, human-quality articles that readers love.

🌟 Why is BrainyPress Different?

  • ⚡ Fully Automated (Set & Forget): Just set a schedule (e.g., “Post every hour”). BrainyPress runs 24/7 in the background, generating fresh content even while you are offline.
  • 🧠 Liquid AI Logic (All Niches Supported): No rigid templates! The AI adapts instantly to ANY Niche.
    • Crypto/Finance: Writes deep technical analysis & price predictions.
    • Food/Recipes: Writes mouth-watering steps with ingredients.
    • News/Sports: Writes journalistic breaking reports.
    • Tech/Reviews: Writes pros/cons and spec comparisons.
  • 🔗 Smart SEO Engine: Automatically weaves Internal Links to your older posts and adds high-authority External Links (Wikipedia, News) to boost SEO authority.
  • 🔍 Real-Time Google Data: Fetches live 2026 data (Prices, Scores, News) before writing. No outdated hallucinations.
  • ✍️ 100% Human-Style Writing: Uses “Storytelling Mode” to avoid robotic lists. The content flows naturally to bypass AI detectors.

🚀 Key Features

  • Auto-Run & Manual Modes: Total control. Run bulk batches instantly or schedule them for drip-feeding.
  • Twitter (X) Auto-Posting: Viral marketing built-in. Automatically tweets your new posts.
  • Free to Use: Built on the generous Free Tier of Gemini API. Zero monthly fees.
  • Crash-Proof: Optimized SQL logic ensures it handles 100+ posts without crashing your server.

Turn your WordPress site into a money-making auto-blog today with BrainyPress.

External Services Disclosure

This plugin relies on third-party API services to function. API keys are stored securely in your database.

1. Google Gemini API (by Google)
* Usage: Generates article text, performs web searches, and structures HTML.
* Privacy: Google Privacy Policy | Terms

2. Twitter / X API (by X Corp)
* Usage: Posts updates to your social feed.
* Privacy: Twitter Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the brainypress folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to BrainyPress settings.
  4. Connect Brain: Enter your Free Google Gemini API Key.
  5. Create Automation: Select a Category and write your Custom Prompt.
  6. Run: The AI will follow your instructions exactly to generate unique content.
sections.faq:
How does “Real-Time Grounding” work?

We use Gemini’s built-in Google Search_retrieval tool. When the AI generates a post, it performs a live search query to gather the most recent information before writing.

Is any user data tracked?

No. BrainyPress does not track user behavior or collect personal data. All API communications happen directly between your WordPress server and the respective service providers (Google/Twitter).

Does this plugin use its own API keys?

No. For your security and control, you must provide your own API keys for both Google Gemini and Twitter. This ensures you have full ownership of your data and usage limits

What is “Liquid AI” Logic?

In previous versions, the plugin had fixed structures (Intro -> H2 -> Conclusion). In v2.8, we removed these limits. The AI now decides the structure based on your Prompt. If you ask for a “Table,” it makes a table. If you ask for a “Story,” it writes a story.

How does the Smart Linking work?

The plugin fetches a random related post from your database and instructs the AI to “weave” that link into the middle of a sentence where it makes sense contextually. It does not just dump links at the bottom.

Is it really Free?

Yes! The plugin software is free, and it uses the “Gemini 2.0 Flash” model, which currently has a generous free tier provided by Google.

Will it create duplicate content?

No. v2.8 includes a “Variation ID” system and an “Avoid List.” The AI is told exactly which topics it has already covered to ensure every batch produces unique angles.
sections.changelog:
2.8 (Major Update)

  • New: Liquid AI Engine – Removed hardcoded HTML structures. AI now strictly obeys the User Prompt for formatting.
  • New: Smart Linking System – Auto-inserts contextual Internal Links and Authority External Links.
  • New: Crash Protection – Replaced heavy WP functions with direct SQL queries for duplicate checking (10x faster).
  • New: Avoidance Logic – Passes recently published titles to AI to prevent topic repetition.
  • Fix: Resolved “Stuck at Posting” timeout issues on slower servers.

2.7

  • Added Post Status (Draft/Publish).
  • Added Twitter Auto-Post.
  • Upgraded to Gemini 2.0.
